manualTimestamps.title: Creación Manual de Marcas de Tiempo
manualTimestamps.description: A diferencia de otras herramientas sobrecargadas del mercado, esta es simple pero poderosa. Te ayuda a crear marcas de tiempo manualmente, lo que garantiza precisión, y la interfaz te ayuda a crearlas 50% más rápido, con controles desde el inicio del capítulo hasta el final del capítulo del video de YouTube.

questions.whatIsAnswer: [ES] Easy Timestamps is a free tool that helps you create professional YouTube timestamps and video chapters quickly and efficiently.
questions.howToUse: [ES] How do I use Easy Timestamps?
questions.howToUseAnswer: [ES] Simply paste a YouTube URL or upload a video file, then add timestamps with titles. You can export the results in various formats.
questions.supportedFormatsAnswer: [ES] We support YouTube URLs and MP4 file uploads. More formats coming soon.
questions.freeToUse: [ES] Is Easy Timestamps free to use?
questions.freeToUseAnswer: [ES] Yes! Easy Timestamps is completely free to use with no hidden fees or subscriptions.
questions.exportFormatsAnswer: [ES] You can export timestamps in YouTube description format, JSON, CSV, and plain text formats.
